policy.scope: The 61 blockers currently reported for the pinned DXVK v2.6.2 D3D11 feature-level 11_0 baseline.

delivery.branching: One fresh topic branch from current main per pull request; no stacked pull requests.
delivery.file_budget: Prefer 3-6 reviewed files per pull request; split a tranche when honest implementation needs more.
delivery.promotion: Never advertise a feature, property, extension or API version before every completion-gate axis passes.
delivery.validation: Host tests are necessary but native PS5 evidence and applicable upstream CTS are required for promotion.

tranches.title: Vulkan 1.1 draw-parameter foundation
tranches.acceptance: Implement BaseVertex/BaseInstance/DrawIndex semantics through public query, device enablement, shader lowering, focused CTS and native readback.

tranches.title: Vulkan 1.1 multiview
tranches.acceptance: Implement view masks and ViewIndex semantics, report measured non-zero limits, and validate layered native output plus focused CTS.

tranches.title: Indirect and indexed draw semantics
tranches.acceptance: Execute the advertised indirect and 32-bit indexed paths on GPU, including firstInstance and multi-draw behavior, with deterministic readback and focused CTS.

tranches.title: Programmable graphics stages and clip/cull distances
tranches.acceptance: Compile, create and execute geometry/tessellation pipelines and clip/cull built-ins with public API coverage, focused CTS and pixel-verified native cases.

tranches.title: Rasterization and viewport state
tranches.acceptance: Lower each advertised fixed-function state to AGC and verify observable native pixels and focused CTS, including non-solid fill and multiple viewports.

tranches.title: Fragment output, blending and multisampling
tranches.acceptance: Implement independent and dual-source blend state, fragment storage/atomics and sample-rate execution with deterministic native verification and focused CTS.

tranches.title: D3D11 resource and precise-query baseline
tranches.acceptance: Implement cube arrays, BC resources, extended gathers and precise occlusion results with format/property reporting, native readback and focused CTS.

tranches.title: Vulkan 1.2 shader and memory model
tranches.acceptance: Provide real address, layout, subgroup and memory-model semantics across public query/device creation, compiler/backend, synchronization, focused CTS and native data validation.

tranches.title: Vulkan 1.2 lifecycle, render and timeline primitives
tranches.acceptance: Implement each lifecycle/render primitive and timeline ordering, report a measured limit, and prove behavior with focused CTS and native synchronization/readback.

tranches.title: Vulkan 1.3 synchronization and dynamic rendering
tranches.acceptance: Implement synchronization2 and dynamic-rendering command semantics, maintenance4 and cache control, then validate the measured maxBufferSize through CTS and native execution.

tranches.title: Vulkan 1.3 shader and subgroup behavior
tranches.acceptance: Implement compiler and runtime semantics for every advertised shader/subgroup feature with focused CTS and deterministic native compute/graphics validation.

tranches.title: Inline uniform blocks and descriptor limits
tranches.acceptance: Implement inline-uniform descriptor allocation, updates, binding and limits; all reported floors must be measured and validated by focused CTS and native descriptor consumers.

tranches.title: VK_EXT_robustness2
tranches.acceptance: Implement the extension's null-descriptor and robust access semantics across supported resource paths before enumerating or accepting the extension.

tranches.title: VK_EXT_transform_feedback
tranches.acceptance: Implement transform-feedback buffers, counters, barriers and geometry-stream selection with focused CTS and deterministic native capture before advertising the extension.

tranches.title: Vulkan 1.3.204 API promotion gate
tranches.acceptance: Promote apiVersion only after every prior profile leaf is satisfied and the wider cumulative Vulkan 1.0-1.3 core contract, applicable upstream CTS, native SDK consumer and repeated lifecycle runs are green.
